fact_previews: SignalRTC is a web application for video communication that does not require installing any software or plugins.
The project was initiated by Alexandre Konioukhov.
The project was based in Montreal, Canada.
The funding goal for the project was $35,307.
The project's funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by August 6, 2015.

fact_previews: The project uses WebRTC for video communication.
The project uses SignalR for text messages and connecting clients for video communication.
A working prototype of the project is available at http://signalrtc.com/.
The web app currently works only on Chrome and Firefox due to WebRTC support limitations.
Video communication is currently possible only between two clients.
